header: Why we are keeping the Kettbach office open
bodytext:
You may have heard that the Kettbach office had a poor year. That is true. It brought in 11% of our turnover and cost us more than that. In October the partners spent two long evenings deciding what to do.

We are keeping it. Kettbach is 40 minutes from Hollerau, or an hour while the B-road is being resurfaced. Without the office, clients in the east of the district would wait until the afternoon for a surveyor who now arrives before nine. We would save money, and you would notice.

What changes: Anja Feuerstein runs the office from January, drawing work moves to Hollerau, and the Tuesday and Thursday opening hours become fixed. If you prefer your job to be handled from Hollerau, tell us.

Thank you for the work you gave us this year. Thank you also to the two clients who called in November to ask if we were closing. We were not, and we were glad you asked us directly.
author: Marlene Ostermann
note: Written 3 December. The change of hours takes effect on 7 January.
